definition_used: The journal or publisher has stated that no further action will be taken.
caution: This is a status notice about the closure of a process, not a substantive finding. It does not directly indicate a problem with research content, authorship, or editorial governance, but it relates to post-publication transparency.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a journal/publisher statement that no further action will be taken, which is a post-publication transparency signal about the status of an investigation or concern.
